meta.notes: In-repo curated stub for SMART_PIPELINE. Not a live web crawl, not official licensed measurements, not a RAG product. Typical fan-print / display-scale proportions and print-tech cross-links only. v1.1 adds more helmets/armor/props plus nozzle, clearance, and technique entries that point at printers.ts / joints.ts.

tech.name: PLA
notes: Default P2S everyday material. Stiff display helmets and props; not for outdoor heat or load-bearing clips.
Use printers.ts PLA auto-best (advisory, not a LAN write).

tech.name: PETG
notes: Tougher than PLA for functional props and outdoor-ish parts; strings if wet or a few degrees too hot. Dry the spool.

tech.name: PA / nylon
notes: Hygroscopic — dry thoroughly. P2S has no active chamber heater; keep the door closed. Advisory preset only, not a LAN command.

tech.name: ABS
notes: P2S has no active chamber heater — keep the door closed and use internal circulation. Better heat resistance than PLA for sun-warmed props.

tech.name: TPU
notes: Print slowly. Soft TPU can struggle through AMS feed paths. Keep walls ≥ 1.6 mm; do not knife-edge flex features.

tech.name: ASA
notes: UV-stable outdoor cousin of ABS. No dedicated FilamentId in printers.ts — plan the ABS auto-best (door closed, no active chamber heater) and say so.
Not a live material crawl. If the user only said ASA, still keep walls ≥ 1.6 mm and do not invent a new preset.

tech.name: carbon-fiber filled
notes: Abrasive. Prefer a hardened nozzle; the P2S supported set is 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm (printers.ts).
No dedicated FilamentId — plan PLA or PETG auto-best from the base polymer the user named. Still 1.6 mm walls unless they insist thinner.

tech.name: 0.4 mm nozzle / 0.2 mm layer
notes: P2S default is a 0.4 mm nozzle and 0.2 mm advisory layer height (printers.ts). Walls stay ≥ 1.6 mm (4× nozzle). Supported nozzles: 0.2 / 0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 mm.

tech.name: 0.2 mm nozzle
notes: P2S supports a 0.2 mm nozzle (printers.ts). Finer detail, slower. Walls still ≥ 1.6 mm unless the user insists thinner; min feature can approach 0.8 mm (2× nozzle).

tech.name: 0.6 mm nozzle
notes: P2S supports a 0.6 mm nozzle (printers.ts). Faster draft / large cosplay shells. Prefer walls ≥ 2.4 mm (4× 0.6).

tech.name: 0.8 mm nozzle
notes: P2S supports a 0.8 mm nozzle (printers.ts). Large props and armor plates. Prefer walls ≥ 3.2 mm (4× 0.8).

tech.name: 0.12 mm layer
notes: Detail pass on the default 0.4 mm nozzle. Still keep walls ≥ 1.6 mm. Advisory only — not a slicer profile write.

tech.name: joint clearances
notes: Use lib/joints.ts P2S / 0.4 mm-nozzle radial/axial tables. Do not invent tighter gaps.

tech.name: P2S build volume
notes: Default printer is Bambu Lab P2S at 256×256×256 mm (lib/printers.ts). Oversize designates a stub alternate (K1 Max / H2D / Prusa XL), it does not silently crop.

tech.name: print-in-place
notes: Print-in-place: one print, separate solids, documented radial/axial gaps. Never union the pin, lid, rotor, ball, or snap hook.

tech.name: split for bed
notes: When 1:1 exceeds 256³, prefer a planned split or a designated larger stub machine over a crushed scale — unless the user asked for a miniature.

tech.name: minimum wall
notes: printRules min wall is 1.6 mm (4× 0.4 mm nozzle). Min feature 0.8 mm (2×). Do not plan knife-edges.

tech.name: fit clearance
notes: Fit wizard (lib/fits.ts) S/M/L grades plus explicit mm. Press L / snap M stay 0.3 mm/side (printRules.clearanceMm). Moving joints still use joints.ts.

tech.name: minimum hole
notes: printRules minHoleMm is 2.5 mm on a 0.4 mm nozzle. Smaller stated holes get lifted unless the user insists.

tech.name: hinge joint
notes: Knuckle hinge from lib/joints.ts: PIP 0.4 mm radial / 0.5 mm axial; removable 0.5 / 0.6 mm. Bore = pin + 2×radial. Do not union the pin or lid.

tech.name: snap-fit
notes: Cantilever snap from lib/joints.ts: 0.3 mm/side gap, 1.6 mm beam (4× nozzle), flex in XY. Do not union hook and catch.

tech.name: ball joint
notes: Captive ball from lib/joints.ts: PIP 0.5 mm radial, removable 0.6 mm. Cavity = ball + 2×radial; neck < ball_d. Not a 3-axis gimbal.

tech.name: multi-part kit
notes: Separate solids, then assemble. joints.ts multi-part column: hinge/pin 0.5 mm radial / 0.6 mm axial. Prefer this over crushing 1:1 to fit the bed.

tech.name: tree supports
notes: Slicer supports for overhangs (helmet visors, cowl ears, hammer heads). Prefer orienting the part on z=0 to reduce them. Advisory note only — DescribePrint does not write a slicer profile.

tech.name: brim
notes: Brim / mouse-ears help tall helmets and staffs stick. First-layer elephant foot can steal 0.2–0.4 mm from holes — keep min hole 2.5 mm and 0.3 mm fit clearance.

tech.name: print orientation
notes: Sit the part on z=0. Strength is best in XY; standing hilts/staffs/gauntlets that miss P2S Z should lay on X instead of being crushed.

tech.name: dry filament
notes: PETG / PA / TPU (and wet PLA) string and under-extrude when wet. Dry the spool. Cross-link the named material's printers.ts preset when present — do not invent temps.

tech.name: bridging
notes: Keep unsupported spans short on a 0.4 mm nozzle. Helmet visors and shield grips print more cleanly as recesses than long air bridges. Cooling follows the material preset (PLA high fan, PETG/ABS low).

tech.name: ironing
notes: Slicer top-surface ironing for plaques and shield faces. Advisory only — not a LAN / profile write. Still keep walls ≥ 1.6 mm.

tech.name: vase mode
notes: Single-wall spiral. Conflicts with the 1.6 mm (4× nozzle) wall rule — only if the user insists, and say so. Not a slicer write.
